programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: Kisah luar biasa tentang seorang pendekar wanita kejam yang bertekad untuk menangkap pembunuh orangtuanya.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers

programme.title: The Blue And The Black Part 2
programme.desc: Perang dan waktu mengubah segalanya. Cinta mereka menjadi lebih dari sekadar reuni, melainkan sebuah perenungan tentang apa yang telah terjadi dan apa yang seharusnya terjadi.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Dalam drama kejahatan yang disutradarai oleh Kuei Chih Hung ini, legenda seni bela diri Chan Koon Tai berperan sebagai seorang pemimpin geng yang menjalankan aksinya di sebuah kafe lokal.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Kueh Chih Hung, sang sutradara pujaan, menampilkan kisah tragedi romantis tentang arwah Lo Meng yang berupaya merasuk ke dalam tubuh cinta sejatinya, namun upayanya justru menjadi bumerang.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: Ada dendam lama di antara keluarga pendukung Ching dan Ming di Kwang Tung. Beberapa tahun kemudian, putra Liang yang bernama Hsiao-hu kembali untuk membalas kematian ayahnya.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: Ada dendam lama di antara keluarga pendukung Ching dan Ming di Kwang Tung. Beberapa tahun kemudian, putra Liang yang bernama Hsiao-hu kembali untuk membalas kematian ayahnya.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: Pendekar pedang Chin Wu-hsin ditugaskan untuk menemukan Pedang Agung milik Elang Tua, namun ia melakukan cara-cara curang untuk mendapatkannya. Kejadian ini menuntun putra Elang Tua untuk membalaskan dendam sang ayah.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng kabur ke San Francisco setelah dijebak atas kepemilikan narkoba. Ia membantu geng Naga Putih nan terkenal, yang dipimpin oleh Philip Kwok, dalam perang antargeng yang mengerikan, tapi ia dikhianati.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Shek Kin, yang biasa berperan sebagai tokoh jahat, mengambil peran langka di film komedi tentang hantu lucu yang berteman dengan seorang anak lelaki dan membantu sang anak menyatukan kembali orangtuanya yang berseteru.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Lily Ho berperan sebagai pendekar pedang wanita yang ditakuti. Ia pernah menyaksikan ayahnya disiksa dan ibunya diperkosa. 18 tahun berlalu sejak peristiwa itu, ia berencana untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei berperan sebagai seorang penyanyi muda bernama Hsiao-Yun yang bimbang antara kesuksesannya dalam karier dan hubungannya dengan sang kekasih, seorang pianis bernama Li Yen-nan.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: Seorang putri bangsawan diculik oleh bandit Golden Dragon Hill yang terkenal kejam. Seorang pendekar pedang bernama Yue Zhen Bei ditugaskan untuk menyelamatkannya, dan ia menghadapi banyak bahaya dalam perjalanannya.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-Killer
programme.desc: Seorang pencinta wanita kaya menulis buku harian tentang petualangan asmaranya, tetapi semua wanita yang pernah diselingkuhinya telah dibunuh.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: Pemerintah Qing menugaskan para petarung untuk menghancurkan Kuil Shaolin dan membunuh semua muridnya, tetapi dua di antaranya berhasil lolos. Mereka berlatih di bawah guru yang berbeda dan berniat membalas dendam.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang adalah seorang gadis yang tidak takut untuk melawan para preman. Sayangnya, ia mengira Ma Ta-hai yang tampan sebagai salah satu preman itu. Keduanya saling tertarik, namun mereka menolak untuk mengakuinya.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Seorang istri yang setia menguak sebuah jaringan pemerasan dan penipuan setelah suaminya ditipu oleh seorang penari perut yang licik. Saat sang penari ditikam, keadaan pun menjadi semakin tak terkendali.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Sutradara asal Jepang, Inoue Umetsugu, menyuguhkan dunia gemerlap dari para penghibur di klub malam dalam sebuah kisah tentang perjuangan dua kakak beradik yang diperankan oleh Irene Chen Yi Ling dan Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Dokter Sing merasa bingung dengan gejala-gejala aneh yang dialami pasiennya dan meminta bantuan pada temannya. Penyakit tersebut rupanya disebabkan oleh ilmu hitam yang dilakukan oleh seorang pria jahat bernama Kong.

programme.title: The Kung-Fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang adalah seorang seniman bela diri terkenal yang dipaksa untuk mengajarkan kung fu ke Klan Mong, sebuah klan jahat yang mencoba menghancurkan musuh bebuyutannya, Klan Chow.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Raja Kera dan gengnya dihadang oleh Putri Kipas Besi yang jahat, Nyonya Tulang Putih dan dua adiknya yang seksi, serta sederet karakter-karakter aneh lainnya.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini menyoroti para master Kung Fu Tiongkok yang terkenal di industri film, memamerkan warisan Kung Fu Hong Kong selama enam puluh tahun dan mengabadikan kehidupan mereka yang penuh tantangan.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: Kaisar muda Kangxi sedang berusaha memilih seorang istri. Ibunya telah mengatur agar beberapa wanita muda yang tersedia mengunjunginya sehingga ia dapat memilih.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda bertemu dengan seorang novelis di sebuah bar dan langsung jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, ternyata ia malah terperangkap ke dalam jebakan yang direkayasa oleh si novelis dan mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: Son Donglu, seorang detektif yang baru dipromosikan, bekerja sama dengan Guo Zhui, penembak tercepat di Tiancheng, dan Xiaowu, seorang polisi pemula, untuk menyelidiki kematian misterius di sebuah pabrik peluru.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan ski. Kemudian, teman sekamarnya, Yoshio, menikahi istrinya serta mewarisi seluruh kekayaannya. Namun, segalanya berubah sejak Yoshio bertemu seorang pria tua di pemakaman Tamotsu.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Seorang detektif Hong Kong mengalami kecelakaan fatal yang melibatkan sebuah medali misterius dan berubah menjadi seorang prajurit abadi dengan kekuatan luar biasa.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Seorang detektif Hong Kong mengalami kecelakaan fatal yang melibatkan sebuah medali misterius dan berubah menjadi seorang prajurit abadi dengan kekuatan luar biasa.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Di Cina tahun 1920-an, seorang bandit tiba di kota provinsi terpencil dengan menyamar sebagai wali kota baru, di mana ia berhadapan dengan bangsawan lokal yang kejam.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba di kota untuk bekerja dengan teman mendiang sang ayah. Ketika toko pewarna mereka dibakar oleh seorang pemimpin geng setempat, ia memutuskan untuk melawan demi melindungi dan menyelamatkan toko.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Seorang panglima perang jahat menerima 2 murid (Angin & Awan) dalam upaya untuk menjadi tak terkalahkan agar dia dapat menguasai dunia.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. B, yang memiliki nama lengkap Benjamin Barker, adalah seorang pegawai kantoran yang menjalani kehidupan monoton. Suatu hari, dalam sebuah insiden aneh di laboratorium ilmiah tempat temannya bekerja, Mr. B terpapar dengan zat misterius yang memberinya kemampuan untuk terbang. Awalnya, dia merasa bingung dan takut, tetapi segera dia mulai mengeksplorasi kekuatan barunya dengan penuh semangat.

programme.title: Iceman (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang pengawal kekaisaran dan tiga teman masa kecilnya yang pengkhianat, yang diperintahkan untuk memburunya, secara tidak sengaja terkubur dan membeku dalam waktu. 400 tahun kemudian berlalu dan mereka dicairkan, melanjutkan pertempuran yang mereka tinggalkan.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Di sebuah pusat perbelanjaan di Hong Kong, intuisi Buck Yuen (Jackie Chan) memperingatkannya. Ia menyelamatkan hasil rampasan perampokan dan muncul di televisi, akhirnya sampai di Istanbul melalui Korea Selatan, dan tanpa sengaja menjadi mata-mata. Untungnya, ia menguasai Kung Fu.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: Setelah menyergap dan membunuh musuh bebuyutannya, namun kehilangan segalanya dalam proses itu, panglima perang Hou Jie yang putus asa mencari penebusan dengan berlindung di sebuah biara Shaolin.

programme.title: Rio Ngumoha : The Big Interview
programme.desc: At just 16 years and 361 days old, Rio Ngumoha became Liverpool's youngest ever goalscorer, scoring a 100th minute winner on his Premier League debut at Newcastle. The records kept on falling in the 2025/26 season as the young winger went from wonderkid to first team regular. The East Londoner reflects on his meteoric rise and the importance of family support along the way.

programme.title: The Tigers Return : PL Stories
programme.desc: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief. We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead, as they aim not just to survive in the Premier League, but to establish themselves there for years to come.

programme.title: Hull City V Brighton & Hove Albion / Liverpool V Manchester United : Premier League LIVE
programme.desc: Premier League Live will be pitch-side at Anfield as the two most successful clubs in English football meet again when Liverpool host Manchester United. That clash at Anfield follows high-flying Brighton's trip to Hull City.

programme.title: Hull City V Brighton & Hove Albion / Liverpool V Manchester United : Premier League LIVE
programme.desc: Premier League Live will be pitch-side at Anfield as the two most successful clubs in English football meet again when Liverpool host Manchester United. That clash at Anfield follows high-flying Brighton's trip to Hull City.

programme.title: Alex Scott : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Alex Scott is the star that might never have been. Flying each weekend from his home island of Guernsey to Southampton's academy, Scott's love for the game was truly tested. His persistence in achieving his dream paid off though, and led to the start of a journey that now sees him as one of the Premier League's brightest young talents.

programme.title: (Subbed) Nemanja Matic : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Nemanja Matic's journey from his upbringing in Serbia to Premier League success with Chelsea and his time at Manchester United. He reflects on the experiences that shaped him, the challenges of establishing himself at the highest level and the managers who influenced his career. Through his story, we explore what it took to become a key figure in midfield for club and country.

programme.title: The Evolution Of The Premier League Goalkeepper : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Peter and Kasper Schmeichel explore how the art of goalkeeping has evolved throughout the Premier League era. From the fundamentals of shot-stopping, positioning and commanding the penalty area to the modern demands of distribution and playing with the ball at your feet, the Schmeichels break down what it takes to be an elite goalkeeper. Featuring some of the Premier League's greatest number ones, the show examines how one of football's most specialised positions has been transformed.

programme.title: 2012: Supernova
programme.desc: Seorang ilmuwan berlomba melawan waktu untuk memasang perisai di antara Bumi dan gelombang ledakan supernova yang mendekat. Di sisi lain, sekte kiamat berusaha menyabotase proyek tersebut dengan keyakinan bahwa hal itu merupakan “kehendak Tuhan” dan membiarkan penduduk Bumi dilalap oleh radiasi intens dari gelombang tersebut.

programme.title: Undercover Files: Betrayal
programme.desc: Undercover Files: Betrayal mengungkap kasus nyata tentang penipuan dan pengkhianatan, menelusuri rahasia tersembunyi serta berbagai rencana berbahaya melalui investigasi, wawancara, dan kisah dramatis.

programme.title: The Healer
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba-tiba menyadari bahwa ia memiliki karunia penyembuhan. Saat ia mencoba memahaminya dan kenyataan baru yang ditawarkannya, seorang gadis remaja dengan kanker stadium akhir tiba-tiba menunjukkan jalan kepadanya.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Dua veteran Perang Bosnia, satu orang Amerika, satu orang Serbia, mendapati persahabatan mereka yang tidak terduga diuji ketika salah satu dari mereka mengungkapkan niat mereka yang sebenarnya.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: Seorang penipu yang berusaha naik dari pekerja karnaval rendahan menjadi medium paranormal terkenal harus adu kecerdikan dengan seorang psikolog yang bertekad membongkar tipu dayanya.

programme.title: My Lucky Star
programme.desc: My Lucky Star mengisahkan Sophie, seorang wanita muda yang bekerja sebagai ilustrator komik dan memiliki impian menjalani kehidupan penuh petualangan. Suatu hari, ia secara tidak sengaja terlibat dalam misi rahasia setelah disangka sebagai seorang agen profesional. Bersama seorang mata-mata misterius, Sophie harus menjalankan misi untuk menemukan berlian berharga sambil menghadapi berbagai bahaya dan musuh. Dalam perjalanan tersebut, ia menemukan keberanian dalam dirinya serta mengalami kisah cinta yang tidak terduga.

programme.title: Hollywoo

programme.title: From Time To Time
programme.desc: Kisah hantu menghantui yang membentang di dua dunia, terpisah lebih dari satu abad. Ketika Tolly yang berusia 13 tahun menyadari bahwa ia dapat secara misterius berpindah di antara keduanya, ia memulai petualangan yang mengungkap rahasia keluarga yang terkubur selama beberapa generasi.

programme.title: Mad Genius
programme.desc: Mason Wells, seorang programmer berbakat dengan pemikiran yang tidak biasa, berhasil mengembangkan teknologi revolusioner yang memungkinkan manusia terhubung dalam dunia bawah sadar yang sama. Penemuannya menarik perhatian pihak-pihak berpengaruh yang ingin memanfaatkan teknologi tersebut demi kepentingan mereka sendiri. Ketika batas antara realitas dan dunia pikiran semakin kabur, Mason harus menghadapi konspirasi, ancaman, dan pertanyaan mendalam mengenai kesadaran, kebebasan, serta dampak dari sebuah inovasi yang melampaui batas kemampuan manusia. Mad Genius memadukan fiksi ilmiah, thriller psikologis, dan misteri dalam sebuah kisah yang penuh ketegangan.

Melalui berbagai pengalaman, Dora perlahan membangun rasa percaya diri, menemukan bakat yang selama ini terpendam, dan belajar berani menentukan jalan hidupnya sendiri. I Dream Too Much merupakan drama komedi yang hangat tentang keluarga, persahabatan, dan perjalanan menemukan jati diri.

Melalui wawancara dengan keluarga, teman, dan rekan kerja, dokumenter ini menggali perjalanan kariernya, kreativitasnya yang luar biasa, kesuksesan karakter ciptaannya, serta perjuangan pribadi yang ia sembunyikan di balik persona panggungnya. programme.title: Ketika Jamu Tak Berhenti Di Sini
programme.desc: kehidupan seorang gadis bernama Molly (Djihan Ranti). Demi mencukupi kebutuhan sehari-hari, Molly dan adiknya berjualan jamu instan di dalam botol di kampus. Usaha Molly dan adiknya itu pun mendapatkan perhatian dari teman-teman kampusnya hingga jamunya banyak dibeli dan pemasarannya dibantu temannya. Meski demikian, Molly masih kesulitan dalam memenuhi kebutuhan hidupnya hingga membayar kos pun ditagih-tagih. Suatu hari, ada peristiwa yang mendekatkan Molly dengan seorang pria bernama Vian (Julian Jacob). Molly dan Vian pun menjadi dekat hingga menimbulkan kecemburuan pacar Vian.

programme.title: Katanya Hidup Itu Indah
programme.desc: Cakra (Munggaran Meldrat) harus kehilangan kakak dan kakak iparnya yang meninggal dunia dan meninggalkan 3 anak yang masih kecil. Demi memenuhi kewajibannya sebagai tulang punggung, Cakra pun bekerja serabutan. Saat sedang berjualan keliling, tanpa sengaja Cakra bertemu dengan Mona (Zoe Jackson) sahabat perempuannya saat kuliah.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Resepsi Disponsori Pawang Hujan
programme.desc: Rara rela berpura-pura jadi pawang hujan buat bayar hutang dan membiayai pengobatan Babehnya, tapi malah ketemu Angga, pemilik WO yang nggak percaya hal-hal mistis. Kedekatan mereka membuatnya saling jatuh cinta, tapi situasi kian rumit ketika Angga tahu kebohongan Rara dan melaporkannya ke polisi. Namun, berakhir bahagia.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: My Beautiful (Ex) Sister
programme.desc: Juna (Rizky Alatas) beserta kakak dan babehnya (Tenno Ali), mengalami kecelakaan yang menyebabkan kakaknya Juna meninggal. Padahal saat itu adalah hari bahagia kakaknya yang ingin melamar Karin (Kharisma Adzana). Mendengar kabar bahwa kekasihnya meninggal, Karin sangat sedih. Karin seperti tidak mempunyai semangat untuk hidup. Babeh yang sudah menganggap Karin sebagai anak, meminta Juna menggantikan posisi kakaknya untuk menikah dengan Karin.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Satu Kontrakan Tujuan Cintanya Kebanyakan
programme.desc: Citra (Ersya Aurelia) pindah ke kontrakan baru. Tak disangka, tetangganya adalah musuh bebuyutannya sekaligus seleb TokTok terkenal, Farrel (Munggaran Meldrat). Pertengkaran kecil sering terjadi di antara mereka, mulai dari hal sepele sampai yang bikin emosi. Tapi justru dari situ, benih-benih cinta mulai tumbuh. Apakah mereka akan terus bertengkar, atau justru saling jatuh hati?

programme.title: Playboy Cap Kuda Terbang
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Miko (Rendy Kjaernett) takut dengan kuda karena pernah jatuh. Nina (Chrissie Vanessa) bekerja di kandang kuda dan sempat membuat takut Miko saat sedang berkeliling menunggangi kuda. Bukan hanya takut pada kuda, Miko juga terkenal playboy. Ia berpacaran dengan Clara (Fristiana Aldila) dan Sherly (Jovanna) yang keduanya bersahabat. Mereka tidak tau kalau pacar mereka adalah orang yang sama. Miko ingin mencari seseorang yang tulus mencintainya bukan karena ia adalah anak seorang pengusaha.

programme.title: Senandung Yang Tak Didengar
programme.desc: Raina (Aline Fauziah) selalu dibandingkan dengan kakaknya, Vinka (Hanifa Alhasni). Raina yang dituntut untuk sempurna menjadikan musik satu-satunya pelarian dari luka dan tekanan. Di tengah ejekan teman-temannya, Abhay (Rassya Hidayah) hadir sebagai pelindung dan penyemangatnya.

programme.desc: Hidup Arga (Emyr Razan) penuh luka dan perjuangan. programme.desc: Diputusin pacarnya karena salah paham Brian mencoba move on. Tanpa disenagaja ia bertemu di rumah sakit, Diam-diam Brian terpikat dengan pesona supir ambilance cantik bernama Dea. Namun perjuangan Brian mendapatkan cinta Dea tidaklah mudah.

programme.title: Bila Esok Oma Tiada
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang seorang gadis cantik sederhana bernama Anna (Larasati Nugroho). Pada suatu hari, Anna yang bekerja sebagai perawat lansia bernama Farida atau disebut Oma (Lilis Suganda) kaget saat bekerja. Ketika Anna akan masuk kamar Oma, ia melihat ada sosok misterius mengenakan pakaian serba hitam dan membekapnya. Ia pun berteriak meminta pertolongan. Anna yakin orang tersebut mempunyai maksud tidak baik kepada Oma hingga Anna diserang sosok jahat itu. Beberapa waktu kemudian, setelah Anna tidak dibekap, ia berteriak meminta tolong hingga tiga cucu laki-laki Farida datang. Mereka pun memeriksa kondisi Farida. Salah seorang cucu Farida yang diperankan oleh Elryan Carlen kaget saat melihat omanya telah meninggal dunia.

programme.title: Greatest Classics S1, Ep 44
programme.desc: FIGHT SPORTS mempersembahkan episode Greatest Classics yang menarik lainnya, menghadirkan lebih banyak aksi yang menampilkan para petinju terbaik dalam sejarah tinju. Dalam sebuah laga perebutan gelar Kejuaraan Kelas Welter NABF yang masih lowong, Derrell Coley (29-1-2) dan Kip Diggs (27-2) akan berhadapan dalam sebuah pertarungan klasik, dengan beberapa kali knockdown dan sebuah pertarungan yang berakhir dengan keputusan juri. Dalam laga pendukung utama, Fernando Vargas muda, yang kemudian merebut gelar Juara Dunia pada tahun berikutnya, mencetak debut profesionalnya di kota kelahirannya, Oxnard, California. Ini adalah kartu pertandingan yang bertumpuk dalam episode Greatest Classics kali ini.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Alvarez Vs Rhodes
programme.desc: Pertandingan utama dalam episode ini mempertemukan Saul (Canelo) Alvarez yang akan mempertahankan gelar juara kelas menengah ringan WBC untuk pertama kalinya, dengan menghadapi sang penantang, Ryan Rhodes. Pertarungan ini berakhir di ronde terakhir setelah serangkaian pukulan yang tak terjawab. Juga dalam kartu pertandingan ini, aksi dari mantan juara kelas berat ringan, Adonis Stevenson.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.desc: Cerita bermula di sebuah rumah sederhana. Rusdi bersama istrinya, Novi, dan ketiga anak mereka, Andra, Novan, dan Vina, sedang berbincang di ruang tamu sambil menonton televisi. Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: Kisah bermula di dalam rumah sederhana Rusdi dan Bi Lila melakukan kesalahan dalam hubungan yang terlarang kemudian melahirkan bayi mungil bernama Cinta. meskipun terlahir dari seorang wanita penghibur Cinta beruntung bertemu dengan Samudra yang tulus sayang kepadanya. Dibintangi oleh Rangga Azof, Mischa Chandrawinta, Dylan Car, Cut Syifa, Angela Gilsha, Ben Kasyafani, Haico Van der Veken, dan lain lainnya

programme.title: Asmara Gen Z Special: Mohan & Aqeela
Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Maya terjebak dalam pernikahan palsu dengan Andrian, pewaris konglomerat yang perlahan jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, dendam Hana membawa Maya ke jurang dan membuatnya dinyatakan tewas. Saat Maya ternyata masih hidup dan berada di tangan Roni, sebuah konspirasi membuatnya percaya bahwa Andrian telah mengkhianatinya.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Sinetron Cinta Seluas Samudra bercerita tentang pernikahan palsu yang terpaksa dijalani Andrian dengan asisten rumah tangganya, Maya, demi menyelamatkan nama baik keluarga pasca-kaburnya sang pengantin asli, perlahan menumbuhkan cinta tulus yang diuji oleh intrik balas dendam. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 18.25 WIB.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

As her career blossoms, Marilyn's relationship with Bob falters, and she struggles to prioritize between her professional and personal lives.

programme.title: Arlington Road [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: The Messengers
programme.desc: When the Solomons trade in the craziness of big-city life for the quiet of a North Dakota farm, little do they expect the nightmare that follows. Soon after arriving, teenage Jess (Kristen Stewart) and her younger brother see terrifying apparitions and endure attacks from a supernatural source. Jess must warn her disbelieving family before it is too late to save them.

programme.title: Messengers 2: The Scarecrow
programme.desc: Sinister events plague a farmer (Norman Reedus) and his family (Heather Stephens, Claire Holt) when he places a scarecrow in his field.

programme.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
programme.desc: Sadie (Lucy Liu), a reporter, investigates an underground cult in Los Angeles which seems to be responsible for a series of grisly murders. While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Coming Soon
programme.desc: Privileged teenage friends Jenny (Gaby Hoffmann), Nell (Tricia Vessey) and Stream (Bonnie Root) spend their senior year on a quest to rid Stream of her virginity. However, Stream wants more than just her first sexual experience. She wants to have an orgasm -- but achieving this proves problematic, as the boys she meets are hardly sensitive enough to provide her the release she seeks. When it becomes clear that Nell and Jenny have never experienced an orgasm either, all three set out to get one.

programme.title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
programme.desc: In the 19th century, a buxom woman (Cassandra Peterson) of mystery and shtick visits a castle inhabited by a fatally cursed family.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

Years later, Tim (Barry Watson) manages to create a normal life for himself -- though he lives without closets and keeps his mattress on the floor. But when he learns of his mother's death, Tim must return home to face his childhood trauma.

programme.desc: A mutual ex-lover (Katee Sackhoff) brings together a group of strangers at a bar in downtown Los Angeles.

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: Steve Clark (James Marsden) is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes).

programme.title: Backtrack
programme.desc: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters.

programme.title: Freeway
programme.desc: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood.

programme.desc: This harrowing tale explores the tangled roots of exploitation and control through one man's nefarious quest to maintain power through elaborate deception. But even the best cons must eventually come to light...

programme.title: Code Duello: From The Tithebanner Saga
programme.desc: Following a cataclysmic collision of galaxies, two survivors navigate the strange new world where they find themselves, searching for a place in society to survive and build a new life together.

programme.title: Senn
programme.desc: Charles Dickens meets Arthur C. Clarke-A lowly factory worker is delivered from a world of misery and discovers his destiny via an ancient object on the other side of the stars.

programme.title: Blood in the Water
programme.desc: While house-sitting for the summer at a palatial spread in the Hollywood Hills, young couple Percy and Veronica find themselves caught up in a love triangle that goes terribly wrong.

programme.title: Nothing in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Quinn is a writer dating Ann, a woman twice his age. His best friend Peter is married to Beth but having a bit of a sexual identity crisis. When a connection sparks between Quinn and Beth, it makes all four reevaluate what love means to them.

programme.title: Pushing Dead
programme.desc: Dan's been HIV positive for 22 years. He's got his $3,000-a-month pill regimen down, but when he deposits a $100 birthday check and suddenly doesn't qualify for his assisted healthcare plan, he's got to scramble to get his life together or risk losing it.

programme.title: You Never Know
programme.desc: Immersed in a world filled with crime, drugs and betrayal, a group of friends have a tough time dealing with the daily pressures of life. With the support of one another, they come up with a plan to overcome their reality.

programme.title: The Man in the Trunk
programme.desc: When an absent friend asks a Lawyer to leave with him in the middle of the night with no questions asked, he must confront the consequences of true friendship. Who is the man in the trunk?

programme.title: The Box in the Attic
programme.desc: After the death of her estranged mother, a troubled woman returns to her childhood home and discovers a sealed box. When she breaks its ancient seal, she unleashes malevolent entities tied to a dark family legacy... and a deadly secret of her own.

programme.title: Charlotte
programme.desc: After running away from home, Charlotte seeks refuge with an older man. Through many questionable revelations, she fears she may have put herself in more danger than where she came from.

programme.title: Power of Grayskull : The Definitive History of He-Man and the Masters of The Universe
programme.desc: Follow the surprising twists and turns of an unlikely, unparalleled pop culture success in this Definitive History of He-Man and the Masters of the Universe.

programme.title: Boulevard! A Hollywood Story
programme.desc: Dickson Hughes and Richard Stapley, two young songwriters and romantic partners, find themselves caught in movie star Gloria Swanson's web when she hires them to write a musical version of "Sunset Boulevard."

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: A Great Divide
programme.desc: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

programme.title: Brother Orange
programme.desc: In 2014, BuzzFeed writer Matt Stopera's phone was stolen from a bar in New York City. A year later, photos of storefronts and a man next to an orange tree mysteriously appeared in his iPhoto stream. Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Brotherhood Of The Wolf [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Crawdaddy
programme.desc: Amid the pandemic, Gwynn grows bored with her relationship with Adam. A sex dream involving their friend Lance ignites fantasies, transforming her COVID bubble into a chaotic love triangle.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: During the Cold War a secret organization created an elite squad of superheroes to defend the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: Judy Moody And The Not Bummer Summer
programme.desc: Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

programme.title: The Last Unicorn
programme.desc: In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

programme.title: Georgia Rule [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: The Temptations
programme.desc: The true story behind the legendary Motown musical sensation is brought to life in this touching miniseries.

programme.title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur (Graham Chapman), along with his squire (Terry Gilliam) and his Knights of the Round Table (John Cleese, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin), as they embark on a fearless quest in search of the elusive Holy Grail. A hysterical, historical tour-de-force from Terry Gilliam and Terry Jones.

programme.title: Find Me Guilty
programme.desc: Imprisoned on a drug charge, mobster Jack DiNorscio refuses to testify against his former associates in the Lucchesi crime family. When an ambitious prosecutor brings him back to court, he decides to defend himself. Initially regarded with disbelief, his forceful presence and knowledge of the law turn the tide of the trial.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: An ex-felon on a path of redemption defies convention and establishes a Chess Club for inner-city teenagers.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: Piranhaconda
programme.desc: After a deranged scientist steals the egg of a hybrid animal, members of a film crew run from the creature before the people become its dinner.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Sonny
programme.desc: After a stint in the army, former male prostitute Sonny Phillips (James Franco) returns to his home in a run-down New Orleans in search of a stable life. However, the financial difficulties faced by his mother, Jewel (Brenda Blethyn), who is also a prostitute, make escaping his former life difficult. With few job prospects, Sonny reluctantly begins working the streets. The only bright spot in his otherwise difficult life is his relationship with Carol (Mena Suvari), Jewel's new protégé.

programme.title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
programme.desc: Life on Earth is rapidly destroyed except for a small area in Eastern Europe.

programme.title: Sharktopus vs. Pteracuda
programme.desc: A half-shark, half-octopus battles a half-pterodactyl, half-barracuda.

programme.title: Battle Creek Brawl
programme.desc: In the 1930s, an effete Chicago mobster (Jose Ferrer) pits a Chinese kicker (Jackie Chan) against a king-size brute called Kiss.

programme.title: Dauntless: The Battle of Midway
programme.desc: Two men fight for survival after their plane crashes into the Pacific Ocean during the Battle of Midway.

programme.title: Blind Dating
programme.desc: Danny (Chris Pine) is a blind man who does not let his impairment get in the way of living his life to the fullest, except when it comes to love. Danny's brother (Eddie Kaye Thomas) sets him up on a series of blind dates, but all of them go disastrously wrong. Just when Danny is about to give up, he meets Leeza (Anjali Jay), a nurse who works for Danny's doctor. There is just one catch: Leeza, who is from India, is promised to another man.

programme.title: Silent House
programme.desc: Sarah (Elizabeth Olsen) is working with her father (Adam Trese) and uncle (Eric Sheffer Stevens) to renovate an old family home to prepare it for sale. Long vacant, the house has no utilities, forcing the trio to rely on battery-operated lanterns to light their way. Sarah becomes separated from her relatives and soon finds she is trapped inside the cabin, with no contact with the outside world. Panic turns to real terror as the young woman experiences events that become increasingly ominous.

programme.title: Black Sabbath
programme.desc: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

programme.title: Quadrophenia
programme.desc: An angst-ridden London youth, Jimmy Cooper (Phil Daniels) escapes the drudgery of his postal job as a member of the Mods, a sharply dressed gang constantly at odds with their rivals, the Rockers. When the Mods and Rockers clash in the coastal town of Brighton, England, it leads to both trouble and an encounter with the lovely Steph (Leslie Ash). Returning to London, Jimmy, who aspires to be like Mod leader Ace Face (Sting), becomes even more disillusioned and longs to return to Brighton.

programme.title: Pete's Meteor
programme.desc: Lives change for members of an Irish family after a meteor crashes in their backyard.

programme.title: Sharktopus vs. Whalewolf
programme.desc: A half-shark, half-octopus battles a hybrid of a killer whale and a wolf.

programme.title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
programme.desc: Jonathan Harker is sent away to Count Dracula's castle to sell him a house in Virna, where he lives. But Count Dracula is a vampire, an undead ghoul living off men's blood. Inspired by a photograph of Lucy Harker, Jonathan's wife, Dracula moves to Virna, bringing with him death and plague... An unusually contemplative version of Dracula, in which the vampire bears the cross of not being able to get old and die.

programme.title: Dog Soldiers
programme.desc: During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor. The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

programme.title: FernGully ... the Last Rainforest
programme.desc: Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

programme.title: Misbehaviour
programme.desc: Miss World 1970: the launch of a revolution. Based on the incredible true story.

programme.title: Saturn 3
programme.desc: A madman (Harvey Keitel) and his shiny robot chase a May-December couple (Farrah Fawcett, Kirk Douglas) doing food research on Saturn's third moon.

programme.title: The Rebound
programme.desc: A newly single woman (Catherine Zeta-Jones) becomes involved with the much-younger man (Justin Bartha) she hired to take care of her children.

programme.title: The Exorcist III
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A romance blossoms between the youngest daughter of a merchant who has fallen on hard times and the mysterious beast her father owes a debt to.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow II
programme.desc: A policeman (Leslie Cheung) and a reformed gangster (Ti Lung) meet their dead friend's twin, employed by a New York mob boss.

programme.title: Galaxy of Terror
programme.desc: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

programme.title: Wild Side
programme.desc: When bank executive Alex Lee (Anne Heche) turns to prostitution in order to make ends meet, she becomes a high-class call girl for criminal clientele like notorious money launderer Bruno Buckingham (Christopher Walken). But, after she's framed by an undercover agent working as Bruno's chauffeur, Alex is forced to help the FBI bring Bruno to justice. Backed into a corner with no way out, Alex decides to make a run for it with Bruno's wife, Virginia (Joan Chen), with whom she's fallen in love.

programme.title: Boyka: Undisputed 4
programme.desc: Boyka accidentally kills an opponent in the ring, forcing him to question everything he's worked for. When he finds out his opponent's widow is in trouble, he becomes her champion in a series of seemingly impossible fights.

programme.title: The Eagle Has Landed
programme.desc: During World War II, Nazi officer Max Radl devises a plan to kidnap or kill the British prime minister. Approved by German Cmdr. Heinrich Himmler, the scheme moves forward with Col. Kurt Steiner leading the mission, aided by Liam Devlin, an Irishman with a deep hatred of England. As the plan unfolds, it seems to be going well -- until certain events threaten the group's shot at success.

programme.title: Emergency Declaration
programme.desc: While investigating a terrorist threat that goes online, Korean authorities discover that a suspect has recently boarded a flight bound for the United States. When a healthy passenger on the same plane suddenly dies, panic erupts both in-flight and on the ground. With steadily decreasing fuel and international refusals to offer aid, the captain and crew take unprecedented emergency measures to save the lives of all on board.

programme.title: Bad City
programme.desc: In poverty-stricken Kaiko City, a corrupt mayoral candidate eliminates rival mafias, prompting a released ex-cop to lead a treacherous battle for justice with a special task force in the gritty underworld.

programme.title: Code of the Assassins
programme.desc: Trained by the best, a young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. Failing to complete his mission, he becomes a fugitive hunted by the government, rival assassin groups and other shadowy killers.

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: A low-level drug dealer joins forces with an ambitious cop to bring down a psychotic cartel kingpin.

programme.title: Big Brother
programme.desc: A former soldier is recruited for his toughest mission yet -- teaching a class of teen delinquents. As he kicks his way into their school and home lives, it becomes clear that his unconventional teaching style might be just what they need.

programme.title: God of War
programme.desc: A maverick commander and a young general join forces to battle pirates who pillage small villages in 16th-century China. The violent clash of wits and weapons will ultimately decide who rules the land.

programme.title: God of War 2
programme.desc: Benevolent healer Seon-ui discovers a divine medicinal substance called 19; she names it Il-yeo-po, and they become friends until Dong Zhuo's soldiers forcibly seize Il-yeo-po.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Honed from childhood to be an elite assassin, Sook-hee embarks on a rampage of violence and revenge to finally earn her freedom and escape her past.

programme.title: Shadow
programme.desc: To finally achieve victory over a rival kingdom, a brilliant general devises an intricate plan involving his wife, a look-alike and two kings.

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: A low-level drug dealer joins forces with an ambitious cop to bring down a psychotic cartel kingpin.

programme.title: Shadow
